bio.text: David Stumbo is the Republican nominee for South Carolina attorney general, having won the June 23, 2026 runoff over state Sen. Stephen Goldfinch; he faces Democratic nominee Richard Hricik on November 3.
He is the circuit solicitor for the 8th Judicial Circuit, covering Abbeville, Greenwood, Laurens and Newberry counties, and is in his fourth term in that office.
WMBF reported that he has spent more than a decade prosecuting criminal cases.
